start: Member phone, Gym tab, a member on a running paid plan with no open question

user_sees: 'Who should answer?' with their own trainer preselected, other ticked trainers and the owner as 'Rohit S.', and 'Any trainer'
must_not: A front-desk person without the trainer tick offered
Full surnames shown

steps.action: Type a question (up to 500 characters) and send (member_ask_trainer)
user_sees: The question in the list, waiting for a reply
must_not: Two questions made by one tap

user_sees: A pop-up on this member's phone: the trainer's first name and the reply; tapping opens the reply
must_not: The pop-up on another member's phone
The reply shown with no name

start: Member phone, Gym tab, 'Who should answer?'

user_sees: Sent; any ticked trainer or the owner may reply
must_not: The question lost because no one was picked

start: Member phone locked, a reply has just come

user_sees: The app opens on the reply (member_questions marks it seen)
must_not: The app opening on the home tab with no reply in sight

steps.action: Send while a question is still open (no reply, not taken back, under 14 days)
user_sees: Refused: OPEN_QUESTION, in plain words
must_not: A second open question made

steps.action: Send a 4th question within 24 hours, an empty question, or 501 characters
user_sees: Refused: TOO_MANY or INVALID
must_not: Text cut and sent without a word

steps.action: Send with no running paid plan, or as a pass member (0074)
user_sees: Refused: NO_PLAN; the newer app hides 'Ask a trainer'
must_not: The question reaching a trainer

start: Member phone, an open question with no reply

user_sees: It shows as taken back; a new question can be sent
must_not: The trainer can still reply to it

steps.action: Try to take back a question that already has a reply
user_sees: Refused: NOT_FOUND
must_not: The reply wiped

user_sees: All the member's questions deleted at once
must_not: Questions kept after leaving

start: Member phone, a question to one trainer

user_sees: Only the picked person; 'Any trainer' goes to every ticked trainer and the owner
must_not: The owner or another trainer reading a question sent to one trainer
The front desk without the tick reading it

user_sees: The question and reply deleted
must_not: Kept beyond 180 days

user_sees: The question with the member's name; the menu badge counts open questions
must_not: Questions this person may not see

must_not: Text cut without a word
